pages.title: Title Theme
pages.text: The title screen of Vectorman, the 1995 Genesis game by BlueSky Software and Sega, plays a short tune of about 26 seconds. The game's credits list one person under "Sound And Music", Jon Holland.

pages.title: The DJ who kept calling
pages.text: According to Sega Retro, Jon Holland was an electronic musician and DJ who had been cold-calling BlueSky Software for some time and had left a demo tape with the company's usual composer, Sam Powell. When Powell was busy with other projects, BlueSky hired Holland for Vectorman. The credits of the game thank Sam Powell.

pages.title: Techno, good or bad
pages.text: GamePro wrote in its review in November 1995 that in Vectorman "the music is techno at its worst, but it's still pretty good".
